items.teacher_evidence: Visible skin-like planes are organized as a light warm plane with restrained warm shadow, narrow highlights, and selective deep-navy contour against saturated print fields.
items.source_preserving_rule: Preserve literal source skin identity; translate only relative value, chroma restraint, cel-shadow/highlight, and contour behavior.
exact_prompt_clauses: render skin as a source-preserved coherent light-to-shadow cel-shaded plane with a restrained warm shadow band, sparse narrow highlight, and selective deep-navy contour
Never assign a fixed skin tone or change source identity
items.validation_probe: Authorized frozen held-out person baseline with visible skin; persist skin_treatment sub-loss and set palette_tone to the maximum of all palette sub-losses.

items.teacher_evidence: Hair-like mass is a deep ink value group with restrained cool teal/cyan and warm coral accent planes, tapered navy containment, and sparse fine strands.
items.source_preserving_rule: Preserve literal source hair color, silhouette, arrangement, and identity while applying relative dark mass grouping, controlled accents, and contour behavior.
exact_prompt_clauses: group hair in its source-preserved silhouette and literal color identity as a dark value mass with restrained cool teal/cyan and warm coral accent planes or rim strands, controlled value blocks, and tapered navy contour
Do not alter hairstyle, hair color, or hair identity
items.validation_probe: Authorized frozen held-out person baseline with visible hair; persist hair_treatment sub-loss independently and prevent masking through max aggregation.

items.teacher_evidence: Garment-like areas resolve into interlocking pale, dark, teal, coral, and warm-yellow print facets separated by clear dark seams and light grain.
items.source_preserving_rule: Preserve source garments and markings while simplifying existing folds and values into limited-palette planes, dark seam anchors, and subtle print texture.
exact_prompt_clauses: simplify clothing into source-preserved garment shapes and markings using a few interlocking value planes, dark seam and edge anchors, selective teal/coral/warm-yellow harmonizing facets, and subtle print texture
Do not replace the source outfit, markings, or logos
items.validation_probe: Authorized frozen held-out person baseline with visible clothing; persist clothing_treatment sub-loss independently and prevent masking through max aggregation.

items.teacher_evidence: Visible lettering is a restrained high-contrast editorial display accent with elegant thin strokes, adaptable support-field placement, and sparse line/dot ornament.
items.source_preserving_rule: Only caller-supplied exact text authorizes lettering; preserve spelling and render no other readable or pseudo-readable text, without copying teacher wording or language.
exact_prompt_clauses: If optional text is supplied, render exactly that verbatim text and no other readable or pseudo-readable text

Use it as an opt-in high-contrast editorial display accent with elegant readable calligraphic/display-like ink on a suitably dark or saturated support field, adaptive orientation and placement, and sparse fine dot/line ornament
Do not copy teacher wording, script, language, logo, or text placement
items.validation_probe: Authorized frozen held-out exact-text case; score conditional typography_dialogue separately from spelling adherence and fail teacher-wording leakage or unrequested text.
